title: SimulateRequest
description: POST /simulate. A what-if: take a normal assess request, change some features (or none: an empty overrides array projects the base trajectory as it is), and see how the assessment would move. Read-only: nothing is stored and no real assessment is produced. Backs the MCP tool simulate_scenario.

overrides.description: Feature changes to apply. Required, but may be empty: an empty array means no changes, so the base trajectory is projected as it is.

mode.description: set: replace the value. add: add value to it. scale: multiply it by value.

project_days.description: Optional horizon for the trend of the scenario.
